origin: Original project vector artwork, 2026-10-02; pre-event research
character: Adult woman, approximately mid-twenties; friendly goth focus helper

layers.head: Face/hair/ears; pivot at (120,180)
layers.eyes-closed: Visible only during blink; default hidden
layers.listening-halo: Teal listening indicator; default opacity zero

blink.implementation: Scale open-eye layer vertically, swap to closed-eye paths, reopen; never scale the whole face

listen.entry_gate: Microphone permission granted AND active user-started capture

nudge.entry_gate: Explicit focus session and fresh opted-in usage threshold; one surfaced nudge

controls.reduce_motion: No transforms, blinking or pulsing; static expression plus text state
controls.mute: Stop companion TTS/audio output immediately; does not imply microphone permission/capture changes
controls.hide: Remove companion visuals/animation only; preserve independent focus status and pause control
controls.pause_session: Stop focus observation/nudges and active listening; distinct from hide/mute

performance: Only animate while visible/active; no work when hidden, paused or app background without a visible opted-in overlay
android: Port geometry to Canvas or VectorDrawable; SVG animations are not directly supported by native VectorDrawable
claims: State reflects executor/service events; no inferred emotion, consciousness, financial pressure, or LLM activation mapping
